pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html[1].source: Water-retaining surfaces face continuous immersion, which differs from rain exposure on a terrace or occasional splashing beside a pool. A proposed membrane and finish must be suitable together for the existing pool surface and intended exposure. We assess compatibility with the existing surface before selecting materials and defining the installation. Pool surround photographs show external tiled work and do not document an internal membrane installation.

Describe the change in water level, when it occurs, the current lining and any previous repairs or reports. Plumbing, fittings and other causes may need separate investigation. Do not drain the pool or remove the lining for this enquiry; access and any preparation must first be agreed with the appropriate responsible parties. The written scope identifies the water-retaining surface, junctions, materials, checks and exclusions.
